answer: Identity-bond decay stops bulk fakes. A new agent posts an 80-unit bond that sheds 5 units each epoch unless verified work renews it, so an idle identity fades like a comet leaving its orbit. Honest agents renew from earnings, gathering nectar from each task, and each renewal leaves an echo peers can audit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 80,000 units plus 5,000 per epoch to sustain, while one honest agent pays 80 once and recovers it in 8 epochs.
